body.x: Fitbit (NYSE: FIT) today unveiled the Fitbit Blaze™ smart fitness watch, its smart, stylish, motivating fitness tracker at the press conference of the CES 2016. The latest addition to Fitbit’s award-winning line of innovative devices, Fitbit Blaze is available today for presale with global retail availability starting in March 2016.

Fitbit Blaze is a smart fitness watch built to help users make the most of user's workouts, with a versatile design to fit user's personal style, and the smart notifications that matter most – all in one sleek timepiece that fits seamlessly into user's life:

Enhanced fitness features like FitStar™ by Fitbit® on-screen workouts, Connected GPS, PurePulse® heart rate tracking, and SmartTrack™ automatic exercise recognition help motivate and push user's fitness further
Focus on style featuring a slim design, easily interchangeable bands and frames, and a beautiful, color touchscreen with a variety of clock faces to fit user's personal style

Curated to fit user's life and focused on the features that make tracking user's health and fitness easier, Fitbit Blaze includes the smart notifications that matter most, like call, text and calendar alerts, so user can stay connected to what’s important, and a long battery life of up to 5 days allows user to keep up with user's life, day and night
"One of the first things we learned in this industry is that fitness is personal – and if something isn’t user's style, user won’t wear it,” said James Park, CEO and Co-Founder of Fitbit.

“With Fitbit Blaze, we pushed the boundaries of what’s possible to create a beautiful, versatile device that can be customized to fit user's personal style – while packing a powerful fitness punch to help user reach user's goals.
